subject: Arkline: GCP renewal and staged capacity uplift
messages:
From: Maria Vasquez <maria.vasquez@arkline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T16:14:00Z
Subject: GCP renewal + capacity request

Hi Marissa,

We're getting ahead of our April 30 renewal and want to discuss expanding our committed footprint on GCP. Usage has been higher than forecasted for our inference tier — we'll need roughly a 30% uplift in committed vGPU-hours and would like a 3-year term option with staged billing (tranches aligned to fiscal quarters).

Can Redwood provide: 
- A draft PO we can route through procurement (attached)
- Pricing table for staged commitment (annualized and staircase options)
- Any SOC2 / security evidence we need to include with procurement

Procurement wants to understand invoicing cadence and whether we can stagger acceptance so we only pay for the initial tranche now and the remainder as capacity rolls out. Also flagging legal: Arkline will want a clause that allows a one-time mid-term commit increase with predefined rates.

CCing procurement: procurement@arkline.com.

Thanks,
Maria Vasquez
Head of Infrastructure, Arkline Health
https://arkline.com

Attachments: Arkline_PO_Draft_v1.pdf (stub)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Maria Vasquez <maria.vasquez@arkline.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-12T18:02:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP renewal + capacity request

Hi Maria — thanks for the clear ask and for sending the draft PO. 

Quick read: we can support a 3-year staircase commitment with staged invoicing. Proposed next steps from our side:
1) Ben will send a pricing matrix with both a flat-annualized option and a staircase (tranche) option you described.
2) Kimberly to scope the procurement evidence (SOC2, retention / audit logs summary) and upload to your secure share.
3) I will draft a short contract addendum language for a one-time mid-term uplift clause (pre-agreed uplift bands).

Operational considerations: we recommend enabling a canary ramp for the first tranche (10–15% of uplift) so apps don't hit throttles. We can configure burst capacity and a smoothing window to avoid cold-start spikes.

Tentative timeline: pricing and SOW by EOD 4/13, addendum and DocuSign envelope by 4/14. Does that work for your procurement team?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Marketplace Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0191

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Maria Vasquez <maria.vasquez@arkline.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-13T17:30:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP renewal + capacity request — pricing options

Hi Maria — attaching two pricing scenarios for ARK-2027-042:
- Option A: 3-year flat commitment (30% uplift applied immediately) — lower per-unit price, single annual invoice schedule
- Option B: 3-year staircase (tranches at Q1, Q3, Q5) — staged billing, mid-term uplift clause included at pre-negotiated bands

Summary highlights:
- We can offer a 6% discount on Option A vs current list if Arkline signs a 36-month term and pre-commits to the uplift.
- Option B offers greater cash-flow flexibility and a one-time mid-term increase capped at +20% at a fixed rate table.

I included a column showing estimated monthly token equivalents and projected unit costs at current usage. If procurement prefers, we can map the invoice tranches to PO line items to avoid reclassification on your side.

Attached: RW_Pricing_Options_Q2_2027.csv, RW_Staircase_Terms_Table.xlsx

Next: Marissa will circulate addendum language and a DocuSign link once you confirm which pricing path you prefer.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Maria Vasquez <maria.vasquez@arkline.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Arkline Procurement <procurement@arkline.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T23:30:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP renewal + capacity request — pricing options

Marissa/Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed both options and prefers Option B (staircase) because it matches our quarter-by-quarter budgeting. A couple of asks before we route to legal and sign: 

1) Please send the DocuSign envelope with the PO and the 3-year addendum so our legal team can run a single review pass.
2) Upload SOC2 Type II report and the minimal evidence packet (retention window, audit log export sample) to our secure transfer link. Procurement will validate evidence before routing the final PO for signature.
3) Confirm the calendarized tranche schedule (we prefer the first tranche to invoice on May 15).

If you can get DocuSign and the evidence by EOD 4/15 we will start legal review and aim to return a countersigned PO within 5 business days.

—Maria
Maria Vasquez
Head of Infrastructure, Arkline Health
procurement@arkline.com
